text: G14 scientific integration review found that independently orthogonalizing each run but retaining native basis identities gives wrong response functionals and inconsistent shared coefficients. General-library implementation uses one explicit all-selected-scans transform per cell/modulator group: Z = Xscaled A, with effective HRFs H D^-1 A, new derived identities, identity output column scales, and original divisors/transform/source basis in receipts. Independent single-run builds provide run-local transforms. Old native-basis semantic readouts must fail; effective-basis point/window readouts must preserve estimates and variances. Per-event peak normalization combined with basis orthogonalization is explicitly rejected until its distinct event-dependent response contract is supported.
